title: Determine the Number of Distinct Binary Search Trees from an Insertion Sequence with Duplicates
problemStatement: Given an insertion sequence that may contain duplicate values, determine how many structurally distinct Binary Search Trees can be produced under the specified duplicate insertion rule.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the insertion sequence. • The third line specifies the duplicate insertion rule.
output: • Print the number of distinct BSTs.
